title: osf bumps agnix-core 0.54.0 → 0.56.1
summary: A dependency-only change: the `osf` crate pins `agnix-core` to `=0.56.1` instead of `=0.54.0`, and Cargo.lock follows with `agnix-core` 0.56.1 and its transitive `agnix-rules` 0.56.4. No source file in the repository changes, so the shape of the system is untouched — what moves is the version of the lint/rule engine that `osf` links against at build time, and therefore the rule set that any osf command exercising agnix will evaluate.

nodes.label: Cargo.lock

nodes.label: osf
nodes.subtitle: the CLI crate
nodes.summary: The crate being built. No source file in it changed; it simply links a newer agnix-core, so any code path that calls into agnix now runs against the newer engine.

nodes.label: agnix-core
nodes.summary: The lint/rule engine dependency. Two minor versions of drift arrive at once, so its public surface and rule behaviour are whatever 0.56.1 defines rather than 0.54.0.

nodes.label: agnix-rules
nodes.summary: The rule data crate that agnix-core depends on. It is not named in any manifest; it moved only because agnix-core 0.56.1 requires 0.56.4, which is exactly the kind of transitive drift a lockfile diff is meant to expose.
